reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co.

I only searched what Pree can see herself: #central-team and the shared files she has access to. Neither has any Brackenwater account files, contract, CRM record or earlier mention of a renewal date. I told her to treat 8 April as unverified until someone checks the contract or CRM, or Brackenwater confirms it in writing. I also offered to draft an internal note asking the account owner to check.

One correction: my reply says I "noted" the date as unverified, but I didn't save it anywhere. It only exists as Pree's message and my reply in that thread. Nothing needed approval, and I didn't send any mail.
